items.title: Monohybrid cross, us ki tashreeh aur testcross (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of the monohybrid cross, its interpretation and the testcross, block for block (PDF 85-86).

blocks.text: Apne tajurbon se Mendel ne yeh nateeja nikala ke har do mukhalif khasiyaton ke jore mein se aik khasiyat F1 hybrids mein nazar nahi aati, lekin F2 ke 1/4 beejon mein wapas aa jati hai. Is ka matlab hai ke jo khasiyat 'ghayab' hui thi woh F1 beejon mein chhupi hui thi.

blocks.alt: Upar se neeche silsila. Homozygous gol beej (RR) aur homozygous jhurridar beej (rr) se matar ke paude ugte hain; gol beej wale paude ke stamens nikal diye jate hain aur doosre paude se pollen us tak laye jate hain. Gametes banne par maada gamete R aur nar gamete r milte hain aur F1 ke heterozygous gol beej (Rr) bante hain. F1 paude ki self pollination se maada gametes R, r aur nar gametes R, r bante hain jo mil kar F2 beej RR, Rr, Rr aur rr dete hain.
blocks.caption: Figure 18.1: Mendel ka monohybrid cross (kitab ki Figure 18.1 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).
blocks.long_description: Labels: Homozygous round seeds (RR), Homozygous wrinkled seeds (rr), Growth, Stamens removed, Pollens, Gamete formation, Female gametes, Male gametes, Fertilization, F1 seeds, Heterozygous round seeds (Rr), F1 Plants, Self pollination, F2 seeds, 3/4 Round seeds, 1/4 Wrinkled seeds.

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Oopar se neeche parhein: RR (gol) aur rr (jhurridar) paudon ke gametes R aur r mil kar F1 mein sirf Rr (gol) dete hain. Phir F1 paudha self-pollinate hota hai: is ke female gametes R ya r aur male gametes R ya r hote hain. Inhein milane se F2 mein RR, Rr, Rr aur rr bante hain: 3/4 gol aur 1/4 jhurridar.
